title: afb.config.v1 — per-user settings payload (AFB backend<->AFB frontend only; not part of afb.execution.v1 wire)
description: Canon of the user settings carried by `afbws.config.settings.v1` (root = the `settings` object) and of the platform defaults carried by `afbws.config.defaults.v1` (`$defs/defaults`). Replaces the parked `draft/` schemas and the legacy `settings` channel payload. Every property is optional: the on-disk user file stores only what the user overrode and a write is a partial patch (blocks `profile`/`interface`/`dataset`/`dashboard`/`form`/`participants` are deep-merged (arrays such as `participants.columns` are replaced whole), `trade` is replaced whole). Not part of the payload any more: `limits` (travels in `auth_ok`), `favorites` (channel `instrument`), `indicators`/`primitives` (channel `gp`), alarms/tradeplans (their own channels). Booleans are real JSON booleans.

name.description: Read-only display name (server-side source: user registry). Present in responses/pushes when set; a client write is ignored.

notify_system.description: System stability notifications (afb.notification.system.v1) — manager role only; a write from any other role is ignored by the server.

layout.title: settings.interface.layout — page offsets and debug flag (formerly top-level `service`).

favorite_datasets.description: Elements are either `dataset-<preset>` keys or indicator ids.

settings_storage.description: Where the per-service form switches (`settings.form.*`) are stored: `server` — in the user file (default), `local` — in the browser's localStorage under identical `form.*` keys. This value itself is always stored on the server.

chart_type.description: Exchange chart rendering: `candles` — Japanese candlesticks (default), `bars` — OHLC bars.

futures_days_to_expiration.description: Days-to-expiration threshold the frontend uses to pick the front futures contract of a derivative: the member with the minimum expiration not earlier than today + N. Default 2, matching `securities.days_to_expiration` in AFB's `config/afb.yaml`.

dataset.title: settings.dataset — chart series styling.
dataset.description: Freeform per-series style config (color/style/panel triplets, e.g. positions.longColor, trades.tradesBColor). Keys vary per series and grow as new series are added — deliberately open string/number maps rather than enumerating dozens of purely presentational keys.

dashboard.title: settings.dashboard — widget grid.
dashboard.description: `cols` is clamped 8-24 by the frontend normalizer rather than enforced here.

trade.title: settings.trade — user trading prefs (replaced whole on write).
trade.description: `default_capital` is persisted by the server into the user's virtual account, not into the settings file; reads return the live value.

default_risk_pct.description: Default risk_factor (%) for a newly created trade plan.

form.title: settings.form — per-service UI switches (deep-merged on write).
form.description: Stored here when `interface.settings_storage` is `server`; otherwise the same keys (`form.<service>.<name>`) live in localStorage.

confirm_delete.description: Ask for confirmation before deleting an alarm (default true).
Ask for confirmation before deleting a graphic primitive (default true).

auto_execute.description: Activate the deal automatically after a plan is published (default false).

editor_left.description: Plan editor is placed beside the list (left) instead of over it (default true).

hide_on_share.description: Hide commercial information when opening the plan description for copying (default false).

risk_top.description: Show the 'Risk and volume' section first in the plan modal (default true).

use_recommended.description: Use the recommended column set and order in the 'Market participants' service (default true); when false the user's `participants.columns` and `participants.widths` apply.

collection_colors.description: Bubble chart of the 'Market participants' service: true - bubbles use the colour of their catalog collection; false (default) - each collection gets its own colour from the project palette in order.

size_by_volume.description: Bubble chart of the 'Market participants' service: true (default) - bubble size is the traded volume; false - all bubbles have one size.

participants.title: settings.participants — view preferences of the 'Market participants' service (deep-merged on write).
participants.description: Stored here when `interface.settings_storage` is `server`; otherwise the same structure lives in localStorage. Sort and bubble axes are kept always; `columns` order applies only when `form.participants.use_recommended` is false.

columns.description: Visible table columns in display order (column ids of `afbws.screener.participants.v1`).

widths.description: Table column widths in px by column id (deep-merged). Applies only when `form.participants.use_recommended` is false.

bubble.description: Selected axes of the bubble chart.

defaults.title: Platform default settings (shared by all users).
defaults.description: Merged under every user's own settings. A write (manager only) requires `dataset`.
